Lemma
[Weighted Hölder compactness] 1. ch6:6.33\group gt-ch06 If $\Omega $ is bounded and a set $S\subset C_*^{k,\alpha }(\Omega )$ is bounded and equicontinuous on $\bar\Omega $, then $S$ is precompact in $C_*^{j,\beta }(\Omega )$ whenever $j+\beta <k+\alpha $.
Proof

\sketch Use Arzela–Ascoli for uniform convergence and (6.82) for convergence in the lower norm.

□
